heading: Wednesday, July 23, 2025
topLine: ByteDance Seed-Prover scores 30/42 at IMO 2025 with Lean proofs.

items.headline: ByteDance Seed-Prover scores 30/42 at IMO 2025 with Lean proofs
items.summary: ByteDance Seed's Seed-Prover and Seed-Geometry wrote formal Lean proofs for IMO 2025 and received 30 points (2/7/7/7/7/0), which is silver-medal level. ByteDance says it confirmed the score with the IMO committee. The problem statements were formalized by hand. Four more days of search after the contest produced a complete proof of Problem 1, bringing the total to five of six problems fully proved.
